parameters.name: CertificateSource
parameters.description:
The source of the certificate.

- BUY: A purchased certificate.

- TEST: A test certificate.

- UPLOAD: An uploaded certificate.

parameters.name: CertificateStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the certificate.

- **issued**: The certificate is issued.

- **revoked**: The certificate is revoked.

- **willExpire**: The certificate is about to expire.

- **expired**: The certificate has expired.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: A keyword for a fuzzy query. The keyword can be a domain name, a certificate name, or a resource ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ShowSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.
